spec.assertion: Structural: a hitCount:60 enemy block exists; sim: doubling count to 120 halves the distinct-proc count (ratio 1.6-2.6). Fails under the nearest-wrong lastBullet / magazine-keyed model (ratio ~1.0, patch inert) and under shotFired (procs in the thousands) or passive (procs ~1).

Live part: the debuff is emitted on the boss channel (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null), durationSec 5 (not durationShots), and is damage-INERT (emptying skill1 leaves all five totals byte-identical). The inertness assertion is the fudge detector — it goes RED if DEF-down was re-encoded as damageTakenPct. Magnitude is it.skip: the schema exposes no enemy-DEF consumer (defPct is documented as SELF DEF and inert).

No-silent-drop: either a second 5.94% buff effect or an unmodeled.skill1 entry naming ATK. Structurally unobservable at scope lock — the boss deals no damage in v1, so an enemy ATK debuff has no consumer by construction.
Target set: block target is 'enemy', and every 5.94% buffApply in the fight has BOTH casterIdx and targetIdx null. Fails under the mis-scope that grants the debuff to allies or self.

Trigger identity: the skill2 block is keyed fullBurstEnter and NO skill2 block is keyed burstCast. Signal is a Burst II sharing the stage with another Burst II in the fixture, so a burstCast key would systematically under-fire on rotations the other unit takes.

Live part: no effect in skill2 is flatDamage/hitRepeat/dot, no buff carries 44.08, no 44.08 buffApply is emitted anywhere, and emptying skill2 leaves ALL totals identical. That last one is the target-set discriminator — the fixture contains an on-recovery consumer ally, so a heal mis-targeted to allies would move that ally's damage. Magnitude is it.skip: no HP pool, and cfg.onEvent has no recovery event kind.

Structural: exactly one flatDamage in the burst slot at atkPct 229.22 with core falsy. Sim: zeroing atkPct strictly lowers signal's total (non-vacuity — also proves she actually casts in this fixture). Fails under a dropped or duplicated burst hit.

spec.kitLine: burst hit takes no Full Burst major
spec.assertion: Forcing noFb:true on the burst flatDamage is a strict no-op across all totals — burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window opens. Fails under the nearest-wrong model that lets the nuke ride the +50% FB major (totals would drop when noFb is forced).

Forcing core:true strictly RAISES signal's total, proving the shipped model does not core (the kit text never says 'core strike damage') and that the core path is reachable, so the noFb no-op assertion above is not vacuous.

Live part: 2-24 distinct procs, all on the boss channel, all attributable to signal (removing the burst buff drops the count to 0), durationSec 10, stat is NOT damageTakenPct, and removing it moves no damage. Magnitude is it.skip for the same missing-primitive reason as skill1 — plus boss DEF at scope lock is itself unmeasured.

fixtures: controlComp('signal', true) for every run — one base run plus seven withPatchedOverride counterfactuals (skill1 count 60->120, skill1 effects emptied, skill2 effects emptied, burst atkPct->0, burst core->true, burst noFb->true, burst buffs removed) = 8 full 180s runs. fixedB3 MUST be true: signal is a Burst II, so without a Burst III the chain never completes, the fight makes zero Full Bursts, and skill2's fullBurstEnter trigger plus the whole burst window would be vacuous. A fixture risk worth flagging: signal shares Burst stage II with the fixture's other Burst II unit, so she may cast on only a subset of rotations — the 'zeroing the burst hit lowers signal's total' assertion is the explicit non-vacuity gate for that, and it goes RED rather than silently passing if she never casts.
gaps: it.skip skill1 DEF -5.94% MAGNITUDE — the effect schema exposes no enemy-DEF consumer (defPct is documented as SELF DEF and inert; damageTakenPct is a separate multiplicative bucket). Only trigger/target/duration are testable.

notes: I had NO tools available in this run, so I could not write scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/signal.test.ts or signal.test-spec.json to disk — the full source and spec are returned inline above for the orchestrator to save. HEADLINE FINDING for the judge: signal's entire team-facing value is DEF shred (5.94% on a 60-round counter, 12.34% on burst), and the effect schema exposes no enemy-DEF consumer at all. The faithful model therefore RECORDS all three debuff lines and moves zero damage; the only unfaithful alternatives are dropping them silently or converting DEF-down into damageTakenPct, which is a different (multiplicative) mechanic and would over-credit. Both the skill1 and burst inertness assertions are written as fudge detectors for exactly that.
